verdict.rationale: The founder-relevant GOV.UK guidance is written as plain second-person explainers rather than statute text. The Innovator Founder page explains eligibility, settlement after 3 years, exact fees split by filing location, and separate in-UK and outside-UK application flows; the Global Talent and Skilled Worker pages explain endorsement, extensions and timing the same way. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a numbered step-by-step walkthrough of the founder application (documents, endorsement, then filing), and independent or hands-on corroboration that non-lawyers can follow the guidance unaided.
